suggestions.quote: If you searched for crowns and bridges in Austin to plan ahead, this page explains what shapes that estimate and what to ask at your visit.
suggestions.why: The sentence is written around a search keyword and reads as SEO filler rather than natural patient-facing prose.
suggestions.fix: Rewrite it plainly, for example: 'This page explains what shapes that estimate and what to ask at your visit.'

suggestions.quote: That is why a fixed number of years would not be honest.
suggestions.why: The 'would not be honest' framing and the short, declarative 'A crown does not work alone' style are common AI patterns.
suggestions.fix: Use a more direct, less self-congratulatory sentence, such as 'That is why your dentist gives an estimate for your own tooth.'

suggestions.quote: The American Dental Association's [MouthHealthy page on crowns and bridges](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/bridges) explains how crowns and bridges are used to restore teeth and replace a missing tooth.
suggestions.why: The URL is plausible, but the slug points to a bridges page and I cannot confirm it covers crowns as described.
suggestions.fix: Open both MouthHealthy links before publishing and adjust the link text if the page covers only bridges.
